negative_flag.meaning: the negative flag passed to Elo.ratingChange, true meaning eloB's rating should decrease
negative_flag.checkpoint: before battleElo applies the rating update

elo_a_before.meaning: simulated eloA score before battleElo applies the update
elo_a_before.checkpoint: before battleElo applies the rating update

elo_b_before.meaning: simulated eloB score before battleElo applies the update
elo_b_before.checkpoint: before battleElo applies the rating update

elo_a_after.meaning: simulated eloA score after battleElo applies the update
elo_a_after.checkpoint: after battleElo applies the rating update

elo_b_after.meaning: simulated eloB score after battleElo applies the update
elo_b_after.checkpoint: after battleElo applies the rating update

better_party_rating_after.meaning: rating of the party that performs better or wins after the update
better_party_rating_after.checkpoint: after battleElo applies the rating update

worse_party_rating_after.meaning: rating of the party that performs worse or loses after the update
worse_party_rating_after.checkpoint: after battleElo applies the rating update

assumptions: battleElo is invoked with a single battle result and the negative flag reflects which party should decrease.
The better-performing party is the one whose rating should rise under the intent; the worse-performing party's rating should fall.
change amounts are symbolic and not numerically specified in the report.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who invokes battleElo or any authorization condition; not needed for the direction relation but noted.
Report gives no concrete elo values or change amounts; the direction relation is formalized symbolically.

limitations: Only the direction_inverted impact is formalized; downstream ranking/matchmaking/reward impacts are out of scope for this plan.
The relation uses symbolic before/after rating symbols; concrete numeric binding is deferred to code/PoC stage.
The negative_flag is a single Boolean observable; the true and false cases are separate report facts but share the same flag symbol at the same checkpoint.
